subject: german
title: Stamp 1: The Gastarbeiter Era
welcome_lead: Stamp the story of Germany's post-war guest workers.
meta_desc: A-Level German adventure on the Gastarbeiter programme from 1955.

concepts.def: Guest workers recruited from southern Europe and Turkey from 1955 onwards.
Recruitment agreement; first signed with Italy in 1955, followed by Spain, Greece, Turkey (1961).
Economic miracle of the 1950s-60s creating massive labour demand.
Recruitment ban introduced in 1973 amid the oil crisis.
Family reunification, transforming temporary workers into settled communities.
Migration background; official statistical category for persons with at least one foreign-born parent.

walkthroughs.body_html: West Germany's first Anwerbeabkommen was signed with Italy in 1955. Further agreements followed: Spain (1960), Greece (1960), Turkey (1961), Morocco (1963), Portugal (1964), Tunisia (1965), Yugoslavia (1968).
The 1961 agreement brought hundreds of thousands of Turkish workers to Germany. Many stayed, brought their families, and today people of Turkish origin form the largest immigrant-origin community.
der Arbeiter = worker. der Migrant = migrant. der Einwanderer = immigrant. die Auswanderung = emigration. die Integration = integration.
